description: Ships Lean Delivery's Proceed authority, governance-file ownership boundary, ordered closure procedure, and named validation-skip rule.
delta: Proceed now authorizes the complete gated task lifecycle through one integration push and cleanup, while explicitly excluding tags, releases, force or destructive pushes, history rewrites, forced cleanup, required-review bypasses, conflict resolution, and unrelated tasks. Lean task branches no longer edit queue or plan governance files; stage applies those changes on the candidate tree. The managed procedure names every closure stop and its mechanical resume, and accepts only test-reported, non-sole-criterion sandbox skips recorded in the handoff.
verification: a clean Lean Delivery upgrade installs git-workflow v8 in all three managed workflow files while preserving consumer-owned text
marker baselines record git-workflow v8 for all three Lean Delivery workflow files
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests pass
